author: Tor Smith
title: Oakland armed kidnapping suspect tossed firearm from car: PD - NewsBreak
text:
By Tor Smith ,
1 hours ago
(KRON) -- An investigation is underway after an armed kidnapping Tuesday led to an arrest and a recovered firearm tossed from the suspect's vehicle, according to the Oakland Police Department.
OPD said the incident occurred just after 5:00 p.m. in the 1700 block of Embarcadero.
When OPD arrived at the scene, police said the female victim told officers that an armed, unknown man "had kidnapped her and driven a short distance before she was able to exit the vehicle."
The victim provided police a description of the suspect's vehicle, and OPD's helicopter, ARGUS, later tracked the vehicle near 10th Avenue and International Boulevard.
"Officers inside ARGUS saw the suspect throw a firearm out of the vehicle window," police said. "OPD officers assigned to Patrol and the Crime Reduction Team (CRT) West arrested the suspect in the 2000 block of San Pablo Avenue after he collided with a parked vehicle. Officers recovered the thrown firearm."
Photo: OPD. OPD said its Special Victims Section is handling the follow-up investigation into the incident.
Anyone with information tied to the case is encouraged to contact investigators at (510) 238-3641.
